title: QuickCompass
description: Always know your direction with QuickCompass.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

QuickCompass adds a compact, always-visible compass icon to the top-left corner of your screen, showing the same directional rotation and behavior as the vanilla Minecraft compass. The compass updates in real time based on the player’s orientation and the world’s spawn point, providing an unobtrusive yet reliable navigation tool without requiring any items in the inventory. Designed to be lightweight and seamless, it integrates directly into the HUD and works automatically in all game modes, ensuring players always know which direction they’re facing.
